{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "# Cell C: episode-level advantage + full context (8B Qwen3)
# Expected: success (~28-31% OOD confirmed at 1.7B scale)
# Reference: _alfworld_exp029_episode_level.yaml (1.7B)

defaults:
  - base

hydra:
  searchpath:
    - pkg://verl.trainer.config

model_path: /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen3_8b_sft_v1/checkpoint-231

system:
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0,1,2,3"

micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 1
ppo_mini_batch_size: 4

trainer:
  project_name: cost-verify-agent-rl
  experiment_name: 8b-cell-c-episode-level
  total_training_steps: 30
  n_gpus_per_node: 4
  val_before_train: True
  test_freq: 5
  save_freq: 999
  local_log_dir: "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/8b-cell-c/"
  default_local_dir: "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/8b-cell-c/"
  logger: ['console', 'wandb']
  max_actor_ckpt_to_keep: 5
  resume_mode: "disable"

actor_rollout_ref:
  model:
    override_config:
      attn_implementation: sdpa
    enable_gradient_checkpointing: true
  actor:
    fsdp_config:
      optimizer_offload: True
    use_ref: True
    use_torch_compile: False
    use_kl_loss: True
    kl_loss_coef: 0.01
    kl_loss_type: low_var_kl
    entropy_coeff: 0.001
    clip_ratio_low: 0.2
    clip_ratio_high: 0.28
    loss_agg_mode: "token-mean"
    grad_clip: 1.0
    ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu: 16384
    optim:
      lr: 5e-7
  ref:
    use_torch_compile: False
    log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu: 16384
  rollout:
    response_length: 1024
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.35
    enable_chunked_prefill: true
    max_model_len: 20480
    temperature: 1.0
    max_num_batched_tokens: 20480
    enforce_eager: True
    val_kwargs:
      do_sample: True
      temperature: 0.4

algorithm:
  adv_estimator: grpo
  gamma: 0.95
  high_level_gamma: 0.95
  norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: True

agent_proxy:
  context_window_mode: "full"
  max_context_window: -1
  step_independent_history_length: 2
  max_turn: 50
  max_actions_per_turn: 1
  max_prompt_length: 16384
  use_turn_scores: True
  enable_think: False

collapse_detection:
  multi_turn_enabled: false

es_manager:
  format_penalty: 0
  train:
    env_groups: 16
    group_size: 8
    env_configs:
      tags: ["AlfworldSG"]
      n_groups: [16]
  val:
    env_groups: 32
    group_size: 1
    env_configs:
      tags: ["AlfworldSG"]
      n_groups: [32]
